gold.user: User1: I want to retrieve all field configurations available in the Jira Cloud platform to understand how fields are organized.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all field configurations with their details.

gold.user: User2: I need to create a new field configuration for my project to customize the fields that will be displayed.
gold.ideal: Creates a new field configuration and returns the created configuration details.

gold.user: User3: I want to delete an obsolete field configuration that is no longer in use.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified field configuration and confirms the deletion.

gold.user: User4: I need to update the name and description of an existing field configuration to reflect recent changes.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified field configuration and returns the updated details.

gold.user: User5: I want to see all fields associated with a specific field configuration to manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of fields associated with the specified field configuration.

gold.user: User6: I need to update the fields in a field configuration to add new fields and remove outdated ones.
gold.ideal: Updates the fields in the specified field configuration and returns the updated list.

gold.user: User7: I want to retrieve all field configuration schemes to understand how they are applied across projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all field configuration schemes with their details.

gold.user: User8: I need to create a new field configuration scheme to apply a specific configuration to multiple projects.
gold.ideal: Creates a new field configuration scheme and returns its details.

gold.user: User9: I want to see the mappings of field configuration schemes to understand their application.
gold.ideal: Returns the mappings of field configuration schemes.

gold.user: User10: I need to check which field configuration scheme is assigned to a specific project.
gold.ideal: Returns the field configuration scheme mapping for the specified project.

gold.user: User11: I want to assign a field configuration scheme to a project to ensure it uses the correct fields.
gold.ideal: Assigns the specified field configuration scheme to the project and confirms the assignment.

gold.user: User12: I need to delete a field configuration scheme that is no longer relevant to our projects.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified field configuration scheme and confirms the deletion.

gold.user: User13: I want to update the details of a field configuration scheme to reflect recent changes in our processes.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified field configuration scheme and returns the updated details.

gold.user: User14: I need to set the mapping for a field configuration scheme to ensure it applies to the right issue types.
gold.ideal: Sets the mapping for the specified field configuration scheme and confirms the update.

gold.user: User15: I want to remove certain issue types from a global field configuration scheme to streamline our processes.
gold.ideal: Removes the specified issue types from the global field configuration scheme and confirms the removal.
